title: OccWorld: Learning a 3D Occupancy World Model for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: future 3D semantic occupancy (4D occupancy forecasting) plus ego trajectory, predicted jointly

control_signal.value: none from a user; past occupancy scene tokens and past ego positions are the inputs, and the model predicts the ego trajectory itself

control_mechanism.value: Ego token is aggregated with scene tokens; GPT-like spatial-temporal transformer autoregressively predicts next scene and ego tokens; no external control signal injected

base_model.value: VQ-VAE occupancy tokenizer (codebook 512, 128-dim, downsampling 4) and GPT-like spatial-temporal generative transformer with 3 scales and U-net aggregation; TPVFormer for camera inputs

datasets.value: Occ3D for 4D occupancy forecasting; nuScenes for motion planning

metrics.value: mIoU and IoU for occupancy forecasting; L2 error and collision rate for planning

controllability_evidence.value: No controllability test. Forecasting: average IoU 26.63 and mIoU 17.13 for 3 s given 2 s history; planning L2 error 1.16 without instance or map annotations

closed_loop.value: No; open-loop autoregressive forecast of 3 s from 2 s history, evaluated against logged data

stated_limitations.value: Fails to forecast new vehicles entering the view; collision rate behind others; worse at longer planning horizons (L2 1.99 at 3 s vs 1.65 for UniAD); a wrong predicted ego trajectory can mislead forecasting

notes: Not a controllable generator: a joint forecaster and planner with no steering input. Included as the no-control baseline type.
